summary: Documents Nile exception-management requirements as process-only controls for exception records, reviewability, traceability, ownership, evidence, and revalidation.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). This source document defines process and recordkeeping requirements that are not directly enforceable from plan fields.

controls.title: Exceptions are documented before use
controls.obligation: Exceptions should be documented before reliance.
controls.reason: Requires exception workflow/document existence, not Terraform resource attributes.

controls.title: Every exception has an accountable owner
controls.obligation: Every exception requires an accountable owner.
controls.reason: Owner assignment is tracked in exception records rather than plan JSON.

controls.title: Exception risk is documented and visible
controls.reason: Risk documentation is process metadata, not a Terraform plan field.

controls.title: Exceptions require expiration and review
controls.source_section: Section 4.4 – Expiration Required; Section 14 – Revalidation Expectations
controls.obligation: Exceptions should not be indefinite without review and should be periodically reassessed.
controls.reason: Expiration dates and review cadence live in exception records, not resource_changes.

controls.title: Compensating controls are documented when available
controls.source_section: Section 4.5 – Compensating Controls Preferred; Section 12 – Compensating Controls
controls.obligation: Alternative protections should be documented when available.
controls.reason: Documented compensating controls cannot be inferred reliably from Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Exception records are reviewable and traceable in GitHub
controls.source_section: Section 3 – Relationship to Project Nile; Section 4.7 – GitHub As System Of Record; Section 15 – Evidence Requirements
controls.obligation: Exceptions must be reviewable, traceable, and stored in GitHub with evidence links.
controls.reason: GitHub storage, traceability, and evidence links are external recordkeeping requirements, not plan attributes.

controls.title: Required exception record fields are completed
controls.obligation: Exception records must include the required identifiers, scope, owner, justifications, dates, status, approval reference, artifacts, evidence links, and notes.
controls.reason: These fields belong to exception records and governance documentation rather than Terraform resources.

controls.title: Ready with Exception requires an exception record
controls.obligation: A gate status of Ready with Exception requires an exception record.
controls.reason: Gate outcomes and linked exception records are process artifacts, not Terraform plan data.

controls.title: Exception records include supporting evidence
controls.obligation: Exception records without evidence should be treated as incomplete.
controls.reason: Evidence links and review artifacts exist outside the Terraform plan schema.

controls.title: Validation verifies exception documentation quality without granting approval
controls.obligation: Validation verifies documentation quality and traceability, but does not approve, create, or override exceptions.
controls.reason: This is role/process guidance and cannot be evaluated from resource_changes.
